Description: The first model used in ChatGPT.

Capable of processing text, image, audio, and video, GPT-4o is faster and more capable than GPT-4. Was accused of being particularly sycophantic. Its removal from ChatGPT led to backlash from users attached to its personality. The variant GPT-4o mini replaced GPT-3.5 in the July 2024 version of ChatGPT.
An early reasoning model (one that can reason through a problem before answering). Slower, but can solve more complex problems, particularly in math, coding and science.
Primarily intended for coding. Particularly long context window of 1 million tokens (around 3,000 pages of text).
Can analyze images and has access to tools such as web search and a Python code execution environment.

GPT-5 can either answer quickly like earlier GPT models or reason before answering like o1 or o3. Rather than a single model, GPT-5 consists of a network of models with different levels of capability, with a router selecting one based on the complexity of the task and other factors.
Allows users to select alternative personalities, such as "friendly", "efficient" or "cynical".
Released in a context of competitive pressure from Google with Gemini. Discontinued as of June 12, 2026.
OpenAI released only two GPT-5.3 models: GPT-5.3-Codex (for coding) in February 2026 and GPT-5.3 Instant (for quick answers) in March 2026.
Focused on enterprise use, with an improved ability to autonomously operate computers and interact with external tools. Needs fewer tokens to solve problems.
Designed for complex, multi-step professional work including agentic coding and computer use. OpenAI released a variant for cyber defense named "GPT-5.5-Cyber".
Released in three versions, from least to most capable: Luna, Terra, and Sol.
